name: Hero — Male
desc: 23 states · 90+ frames: idle/walk/run/jump/dash, sword ×2, bow, pickaxe, axe, shield block, cheer, hurt, death, sleep, eat, sit, pickup, cast.

name: Hero — Female
desc: Same 23-state suite with long hair, bow tie, tunic palette and full action set.

name: Archmage Wizard
desc: Pointed hat, flowing robe and beard: idle, walk, staff arcane aura, fireball surge, teleport blink.

name: Villager — Male
desc: Idle, walk ×2, talk, sit, sleep. Townsfolk for quests and shops.

name: Villager — Female
desc: Idle, walk ×2, talk, sit, sleep with long-hair variant.

name: Merchant
desc: Robed trader with wide-brim hat. Idle, walk, bow, hurt, death.

name: Skeleton Warrior
desc: Undead swordsman: idle, walk ×2, sword attack, hurt, bone-scatter death.

name: Orc Brute
desc: Green bruiser with tusks and shoulder pads. Full 6-state combat suite.

name: Baby Drake
desc: Miniature dragon: idle hover, wing flap, fire breath attack, sleep, hurt.

name: Slime
desc: Squash & stretch blob: idle, walk, jump, hurt, melting death.

name: Cave Bat
desc: Flapping fly cycle, hurt flash, grounded death.

name: Ghost
desc: Sine-wave float, wavy hem, vanish fade-out.

name: Mushroomling
desc: Bouncy cap creature: idle, waddle walk, hurt, squash death.

name: Stone Golem
desc: Heavy rock brute with crystal core, moss and crack detail.

name: Dire Wolf
desc: Quadruped gallop cycle, lunge attack, hurt and death.

name: Wild Boar
desc: Trot, charge with tusk thrust, dust kick, hurt and comical death.

name: Goblin Boar-rider
desc: Charging goblin on a war boar: trot, lowered lance thrust with impact, hurt and death. Reuses the boar mount with a red war saddle.

name: Chicken
desc: Hop walk, wing flap, peck and comical death. Survival food source.

name: Starter Tileset 4×4
desc: 16 tiles on a 64×64 sheet: grass, flowers, dirt, stone, brick, planks, sand, lava, ice, fence, water edge + more.

name: Animated Water
desc: 4-frame flowing water with sine wave bands and sparkles.

name: Trees & Props
desc: Oak, pine, bush, flowers and grass tuft with swaying 2-4 frame idle loops (plus a very still rock).

name: Magic Crystal Node
desc: 4-frame glowing amethyst core pulse, pickaxe fracture and gem shatter.

name: Campfire
desc: 4-frame flickering fire with logs, stone ring and rising sparks.

name: Torch
desc: 4-frame wall torch flame for dungeons and caves.

name: Treasure Chest
desc: Closed idle + 4-frame lid-open burst with gold sparkles.

name: Dungeon Door
desc: Closed + opening states with glowing passage.

name: Portal
desc: 4-frame swirling magic gate with stone pillars.

name: Weapons Rack
desc: Sword, pickaxe, axe, bow, shield, staff, arrow and bomb — one state each.

name: Potions & Food
desc: 4 potions + apple, bread, meat, carrot, cheese, key, heart, wood, stone.

name: Coin & Gem
desc: 6-frame gold spin + 4-frame floating gem with sparkles.

name: Magic Spells Pack
desc: Flying fireball + burst, downward lightning bolt, expanding ice nova, divine shield.

name: Combat FX Pack
desc: Slash arcs, hit sparks, dust puffs, level-up burst and heal crosses.

name: HUD Hearts & Bars
desc: 5/3/1/0 HP heart rows plus stamina and XP bars.

name: Knight
desc: Plate-armored sword & shield fighter — 15 states / 67 frames: idle & walk x3, six-frame run x3, four-directional sword arcs, shield block, hurt, death.

name: Ranger
desc: Hooded archer — 14 states / 63 frames: idle & walk x3, run x3, five-frame bow draw & release on every facing, sneaky stride, hurt, death.

name: Cleric
desc: Holy healer with circlet and staff — 16 states / 71 frames: idle & walk x3, run x3, four-directional strikes, radiant cast front & side, hurt, death.

name: Rogue
desc: Shadowy hooded dagger fighter — 14 states / 63 frames: idle & walk x3, run x3, four-directional slashes, hurt, death.

name: Townsfolk Pack
desc: King, guard, blacksmith, elder, peasant and cook — blinking 4-frame idles, one state each.

name: Goblin Sneak
desc: Big-eared green skirmisher — 14 states / 63 frames: idle & walk x3, run x3, four-directional dagger slashes, hurt, dither-fade death.

name: Necromancer
desc: Skull-faced dark caster — 16 states / 71 frames: idle & walk x3, run x3, four-directional strikes, shadow cast front & side, hurt, death.

name: Horned Demon
desc: Winged brute with horns and tail — 14 states / 63 frames: idle & walk x3, run x3, four-directional heavy slashes, hurt, death.

name: Red Dragon
desc: Flying boss: idle with smoke, 4-frame wing flap flight, growing fireball spit, hurt, collapse death.

name: Giant Spider
desc: Eight-legged crawler: breathing idle, alternating-gait crawl, rear-up lunge, web spit, hurt, death.

name: Spiderling Swarm
desc: Pale-green hatchling on the same rig: fast skittering crawl, hop lunge, quick hurt and death. Spawn in packs.

name: Spider Queen
desc: Brood-mother boss: egg-laden abdomen, gold carapace marks, ring of eyes, heavy crawl, lunge and web spit.

name: Mimic Chest
desc: Treacherous chest: breathing lid, 4-stage teeth snap with tongue lash, coin-spilling death.

name: Will-o-Wisp
desc: Flickering flame spirit: idle, stretch dash with afterimage, spark burst, vanish fade.

name: Slime King
desc: Crowned royal blob: squash idle, hop, ground-slam shockwave, melting crown-drop death.

name: Ancient Ent
desc: Living tree guardian: leaf-sway idle, root stomp, branch slam shockwave, leaf-burst death.

name: Dungeon Tileset
desc: 16 tiles on a 64x64 sheet: stone, cracked, mossy, rune floor, bricks, pillar, lava, water, stairs, spikes, grate, bones, carpet, void, carved.

name: Village Props
desc: Cottage with chimney smoke, well, market stall, signpost, flickering lamp, 4-frame fountain.

name: Dungeon Props
desc: Pillars, candle altar, sarcophagus, bones, swaying chains, iron door, statue, glowshrooms, throne.

name: Rune Savepoint
desc: Glowing monolith with sequential runes, floating crystal, idle pulse + activation burst.

name: Waterfall
desc: 4-frame scrolling falls with cliff ledges, foam basin and drifting mist.

name: Lava Pool
desc: 4-frame bubbling lava: glowing cracks, rising bubbles, drifting embers.

name: Armor Rack
desc: Knight helm, hood, wizard hat, crown, plate, leather, robe, boots, cape, round shield.

name: Arsenal
desc: Greatsword, katana, dagger, spear, warhammer, crossbow, wand, mace, bomb, arrows.

name: Loot Hoard
desc: Coin pile, gems, money bag, scroll, spellbook, treasure map, elixir, feather, fang, ore, ingot, herb.

name: Status Icons
desc: Twelve 16px RPG status icons: burn, poison, frozen, stun, sleep, regen, shield, attack/defense up, haste, curse, paralysis.

name: Battle Magic 2
desc: Tornado, meteor impact, heal beam, summon circle, 5-frame explosion, frost shards, poison cloud.

name: RPG UI Chrome
desc: Dialog box, button x3 states, cursor, bouncing arrow, coin/lock/skull icons, twinkling star.

name: Paladin
desc: Holy sword & shield champion — 17 states / 75 frames: idle & walk x3, run x3, four-directional strikes, shield block, radiant cast front & side, gold cape, sun circlet.

name: Druid
desc: Forest keeper with oak staff and thorn cast — 16 states / 71 frames: idle & walk x3, run x3, four-directional strikes, cast front & side, leaf hood, moss cape.

name: Lich Lord
desc: Undead skull-faced overlord — 16 states / 71 frames: crouched run x3, four-directional strikes, shadow staff cast front & side, dither-fade death.

name: Ogre Mauler
desc: Horned heavy bruiser with iron pauldrons — 14 states / 63 frames: idle & walk x3, run x3, four-directional axe sweeps, hurt, death.

name: Campsite Props
desc: Canvas tent with swinging flap, waving war banner, anvil, bedroll, 4-frame bubbling cookpot, supply crate.

name: Trinkets
desc: Gold ring, amulet, mana orb, war horn, lantern, drum, flute, spirit mask.

name: Battle Magic 3
desc: Holy smite beam, travelling shadow orb with implode, forked storm strike, rising vine grasp.

name: Barbarian
desc: Fur-mantled axe brute — 14 states / 63 frames: idle, walk and run x3, four-directional axe arcs, hurt, death.

name: Monk
desc: Shaven-headed staff master with a long white beard — 16 states / 71 frames: locomotion x3, four-directional strikes, chi cast front and side.

name: Bard
desc: Plumed hat, motley doublet and a lute — 16 states / 71 frames: locomotion x3, four-directional strums, sonic cast with sparkle particles.

name: Ninja
desc: Indigo gi and crimson scarf with a silent crouched stride — 14 states / 63 frames: locomotion x3, four-directional blade arcs, hurt, death.

name: Bandit
desc: Hooded green cutthroat with a sneak stride — 14 states / 63 frames: locomotion x3, four-directional slashes, hurt, death.

name: Cultist
desc: Crimson-robed zealot with a blood-red cast aura — 16 states / 71 frames: locomotion x3, four-directional strikes, cast front and side.

name: Minotaur
desc: Horned bull brute with scrap pauldrons — 14 states / 63 frames: locomotion x3, four-directional axe arcs, hurt, death.

name: Warlord
desc: Blackened plate, horned helm and a crimson cape — 15 states / 67 frames: locomotion x3, four-directional axe arcs, shield block, hurt, death.

name: Farm & Forest Animals
desc: Cow, sheep, pig, horse, rabbit and deer on a shared quadruped rig — 18 states / 72 frames: each gets a breathing idle, a four-beat walk and a head-down graze.

name: Pond Frog
desc: Squat green hopper — 5 states / 17 frames: resting idle, four-frame hop, throat-puffing croak, hurt and squash death.

name: Duck
desc: Waterfowl with a boat-shaped hull — 5 states / 17 frames: idle, waddling walk, glide, hurt and comical death.

name: Wraith
desc: Hooded spectre with a tattered hem and cold blue eyes — 5 states / 17 frames: floating idle, soul-drain cast, lunge, hurt, dither vanish.

name: Gargoyle
desc: Mossy stone sentinel — 5 states / 18 frames: crouched perch, wing-spread swoop, ground slam, hurt and a crumbling two-stage death.

name: Imp
desc: Small winged nuisance with a barbed tail — 5 states / 18 frames: flapping idle, dart, hex spark, hurt and fade death.

name: Dungeon Traps
desc: Eight animated hazards on one sheet — 8 states / 26 frames: floor spikes, wall darts, pendulum blade, pressure plate, flame jet, bear trap, spike pit and swinging chain ball.

name: Interior Furniture
desc: Ten pieces for houses, inns and keeps — 10 states / 10 frames: table, chair, bed, bookshelf, barrel, crate stack, clay pot, rug, candelabra and stool.

name: Weather Overlays
desc: Eight full-tile ambient overlays — 8 states / 32 frames: rain, snow, lightning storm, stippled fog banks, falling leaves, drifting ash, fireflies and sandstorm.

name: Crusader
desc: Holy Knight of the Order — 16 states / 71 frames: greathelm with cross-slit visor, red St. George cross surcoat, flanged mace, kite shield, holy smite cast.

name: Valkyrie
desc: Winged helm and spear champion — 16 states / 71 frames: silver plate cuirass, azure mantle, golden braids, celestial spear, divine ray cast.

name: Blacksmith
desc: Artisan village weaponsmith — 16 states / 71 frames: leather work apron, thick dark beard, heavy smith hammer, forge spark strike cast.

name: Court Jester
desc: Royal palace entertainer — 16 states / 71 frames: three-pointed bell cap, motley quartered doublet, acrobat rapier, confetti trick magic.

name: Executioner
desc: Dread headsman — 15 states / 67 frames: deep black executioner hood with slit eyes, studded harness, gargantuan cleaving greataxe.

name: Death Knight
desc: Unholy scourge champion — 16 states / 71 frames: spiked gothic helm with cyan runic gaze, frost runeblade, plague cast, tattered shroud.

name: Armored Warhorse
desc: Barded medieval destrier — 6 states / 24 frames: breathing idle, disciplined trot, full 6-frame battle gallop, majestic rear, hurt, death.

name: Heraldic Griffin
desc: Legendary beast of crest and banner — 6 states / 22 frames: perched idle, predatory stalk, 4-frame flight flap cycle, razor talon dive attack, hurt, death.

name: Siege Engines
desc: Medieval siege warfare machines — 5 states / 19 frames: heavy catapult rock throw, trebuchet fire shot, ballista bolt release, battering ram impact, archer mantlet.

name: Castle Keep
desc: Medieval fortress and dungeon keep fixtures — 8 states / 27 frames: winched iron portcullis, roaring brazier, royal lion throne, armory weapon rack, pillory stocks, council war table, heraldic lion banner, wheel chandelier.

name: Tiny Blade
desc: Militia swordfighter with kettle helm and shield — 67 states / 324 frames: idle/walk/run/attack/ready/parry/evade/bash across all 8 facings, block, hurt, death.

name: Tiny Pike
desc: Defensive spear guard with morion helm — 67 states / 324 frames: eight-facing locomotion, spear thrusts, ready/parry/evade/bash, block, hurt, death.

name: Tiny Bow
desc: Hooded shortbow skirmisher — 59 states / 286 frames: eight-facing locomotion, six-frame draw with a held anchor and fast release, sneaky stride, ready/parry/evade, hurt, death.

name: Tiny Friar
desc: Wool-robed healer with mend cast — 60 states / 288 frames: eight-facing locomotion, staff strikes, upright cast front and side, ready/parry/evade, hurt, death.

name: Tiny Drudge
desc: Worker pawn with hatchet chop and crate-carry loop — 59 states / 284 frames: idle/walk/run/attack/ready/parry/evade x8 facings, gather, carry, hurt, death.

name: Smith at the Anvil
desc: Five-frame hammer swing at a war anvil — raise, held windup, one fast strike landing the spark, rebound and settle. Plus a four-frame forge quench loop.

name: Farmer at Work
desc: Four distinct verbs, not one swing recoloured: till with a hoe and throw a clod, plant from a seed bag, water in an arcing stream, harvest with a sickle and puff the stubble.

name: Angler
desc: Eight-frame beat: wind up, cast, line settles, wait, rod jerks on the bite, two reels, fish held up. Bobber and splash sit at a fixed water point so the strike reads as a catch.

name: Climber
desc: Five-frame hand-over-hand ascent that resets each cycle so it holds still against a scrolling wall. Legs are posed, not walked: a climb is the one action no sine gait fits.

name: Resting Poses
desc: Seven seated states on a dedicated hip-anchored rig: stool, floor, knees-up, dozing nod, reclined toe-tap, drinking and a shocked emote. Breath drives head and torso on separate beats so every frame differs.

name: Spear Combat
desc: Twelve polearm states across side/down/up: draw, combat-ready stance and step, slash, two thrusts, parry, evade, lunge, retreat, hit and knockdown. Thrusts drive the whole body forward, which is what sells reach.
